questions.stem: 在漁民世代居住的村落，許多房屋和肥沃的農田正逐漸被上升的海水淹沒。
questions.answer: In villages where fishermen have lived for generations, many houses and fertile fields are gradually being flooded by the rising sea.
accepted_answers: In villages where fishing families have lived for generations, many homes and fertile farms are slowly being swallowed up by rising seawater.
Many houses and fertile fields are gradually being covered by the rising sea in villages where fishermen have lived for generations.

questions.stem: 無論海堤蓋得多高，都無法完全保護居民辛苦建立的家園和漁港。
questions.answer: No matter how high the sea walls are, they can't completely protect the homes and harbors that residents have worked hard to build.
accepted_answers: No matter how tall the sea walls are built, they cannot entirely protect the homes and harbors that residents have worked so hard to build.
No matter how high we build the sea walls, they cannot completely protect the homes and fishing ports that local people have built through hard work.

1.explanation_zh: 「漁民世代居住的村落」是地點名詞加修飾語，英文把修飾語改成放在後面的關係子句，用關係副詞 where（＝in which）：villages where fishermen have lived for generations；live 是不及物動詞，不能用 which 直接接。「正逐漸被上升的海水淹沒」是正在進行的被動：are gradually being flooded by the rising sea；「上升的」用 rising（rise 不及物）。
evidence: 正逐漸被上升的海水淹沒
1.strategy_zh: 地點名詞前面有一長串「…的」修飾語時，先想 N(地點) + where + S + V；「正在被…」用 be being p.p.。
hints: 切成四段：在漁民世代居住的村落／許多房屋和肥沃的農田／正逐漸被／上升的海水淹沒
標的詞彙：village（村落）、generation（世代）、field（農田；肥沃的 fertile）、gradually（逐漸地）、flood（淹沒）、rise（上升）
句型框架：In + 地點N + where + S + have p.p. + for generations, S + are (gradually) being p.p. + by …

2.explanation_zh: 「無論海堤蓋得多高」是讓步子句：No matter how high the sea walls are (built)，how 後面緊接形容詞，再接主詞與動詞（直述句語序）。「都無法完全保護」是部分否定 cannot completely protect；「都」是語氣，不必譯成 all。「居民辛苦建立的家園和漁港」用關係代名詞引導的形容詞子句放在名詞後面：the homes and harbors that residents have worked hard to build（that 是 build 的受詞，句尾不再加 them）。
evidence: 居民辛苦建立的家園和漁港
2.strategy_zh: 「無論多…」直接套 No matter how + adj. + S + V；名詞前面有「某人做了…的」修飾語，英文改成 N + that + S + V。
hints: 切成四段：無論海堤蓋得多高／都無法完全保護／居民辛苦建立的／家園和漁港
標的詞彙：sea wall（海堤）、protect（保護）、completely（完全地）、resident（居民）、home（家園）、harbor（港口）
句型框架：No matter how + adj. + S + V, S + cannot completely + V + N + that + S + have worked hard to VR

1.translation: In villages where fishermen have lived for generations, many houses and fertile farmland are gradually being flooded by rising seawater.
1.explanation_zh: 「漁民世代居住的村落」用關係副詞 where 修飾 villages，「世代居住」到現在仍持續，用現在完成式 have lived for generations；「正逐漸被淹沒」是進行中的被動，用 are gradually being flooded；farmland 不可數，不加 s。

2.translation: No matter how high the seawalls are built, they cannot completely protect the homes and fishing ports that residents have worked hard to build.
2.explanation_zh: 「無論……多高」用 No matter how + 形容詞 + S + V；海堤是被蓋的，用被動 are built；「居民辛苦建立的家園和漁港」用 that 關係子句修飾，辛苦建立到現在用現在完成式 have worked hard to build；「無法完全」寫 cannot completely。

issues_zh: （小建議，不影響判定）第 3 部分 accepted 的 that residents built with their own hands 沒有譯出「辛苦」，也沒有完成式，比其他寫法寬鬆；可考慮刪除或改成 that residents have built with their own hands through hard work。

1.translation: In the village where fishermen have lived for generations, many houses and fertile farmland are gradually being swallowed up by the rising sea.
1.explanation_zh: 「漁民世代居住的村落」用關係副詞 where 加現在完成式 have lived for generations；「正逐漸被…淹沒」是進行式被動 are gradually being swallowed up；「上升的海水」用 the rising sea。中文「村落」未明說單複數，我選單數 the village；「淹沒」有 flood／submerge／swallow up 多種譯法，所以信心給 medium。

2.translation: No matter how high a seawall is built, it cannot completely protect the homes and fishing ports that the residents have worked so hard to build.
2.explanation_zh: 「無論…多高」用 No matter how high …（也可用 However high）；「蓋得多高」用被動 is built；「無法完全保護」是部分否定 cannot completely protect；「居民辛苦建立的家園和漁港」用關係子句 that the residents have worked so hard to build，現在完成式表示成果延續到現在。

issues_zh: 第 1 部分（在漁民世代居住的村落）的 accepted 全部是複數 villages（或 fishing villages），沒有單數的 the village。中文「村落」沒有標示單複數，後面「許多房屋和肥沃的農田」也可以屬於同一個村落，所以單數 In the village where fishermen have lived for generations 是自然又正確的譯法，卻落在可接受寫法之外。
建議在第 1 部分補上單數寫法（In the village where fishermen have lived for generations、In the fishing village where …），或把題目中文寫明是「一個漁村」或「好幾個漁村」，避免單複數歧義。
